entries.zh: 指；指点、指出（教人如何指认）
entries.en: to point out, to indicate; to teach (someone) to point
entries.notes: M 栏中段残损，'aunnādo' 不可复原，义依 L/H/R 三栏定。

entries.zh: 法；教法、教理（所传的教义）
entries.en: doctrine, teaching; to teach doctrine
entries.notes: M 栏 'jsīna' 难以复原、R 声调污损，义依 H「法」与 L dotrina 定。

entries.en: to teach and correct; to instruct
entries.notes: M 栏 'conjunto' 系注明「教训」二字典为一词连读。

entries.en: to teach, to instruct; teaching
to teach, to instruct; to show
to guide and instruct; to admonish
entries.notes: M 栏 'conjuntos' 注明「导谕」连读为一词。

entries.en: rules, precepts; to teach discipline
entries.notes: M 栏 'quiey.st' 疑为旁注缩写且带 T99，义依 H「规矩」与 R 定。

entries.en: instruction by a superior or elder; family upbringing
entries.notes: L 作「enseñar el superior」（尊长施教），H 作「家教」，以「尊长之教」相通。

entries.en: to point out, to guide; guidance

entries.zh: 道明；讲明、阐明（以仁爱教导）
entries.en: to explain clearly; to teach with charity
entries.notes: R 作 tān mîng 与 M 之 tō bēng 声母不合（或为「谈明」），义依 H「道明」与 L 定。

entries.en: to indicate (by pointing); to point out
to instruct and admonish; admonition

entries.zh: 传下手；把所学传授给下手（后学）
entries.en: to hand down (teaching or craft) to a successor
entries.notes: R 第三音节作 chý，与 H 末字「手」不合，M/R 略有出入。

entries.en: to advise gently; gentle admonition

entries.zh: 传后世；把道理传给后代子孙
entries.en: to hand down to posterity; to transmit to descendants
entries.notes: L 末尾残损（'a los de cendiente' 即 descendientes），义依 H/M/R 互补而定。

entries.zh: 师传（第二字原稿疑「傅」或「传」）；师父的个别传授
entries.en: a master's individual instruction (second character uncertain: 傅 or 傳)
entries.notes: L 之 'ca' 为缩写（cada/cosa 未定），H 第二字带 [疑]，故存疑。

entries.en: to shut up, to imprison; imprisonment
entries.notes: L 末残，M 之「: ca.」疑为异读或旁注，义依 H「监」与 R 定。

entries.en: to imprison, to confine

entries.zh: 含；含藏、包含（如含藏奥义）
entries.en: to contain within itself, to hold (mysteries)

entries.zh: 包含；包藏、含藏（重大奥义）
entries.en: to contain, to encompass (great mysteries)
entries.notes: H 第二字带 [疑:包/色]，然 M「páu hām」与 R 均指向「包含」。
